question: Can a contour-only centerline visibility rule restore full-lamp silhouette readability while preserving hatch hiding and isolated local edits?
changed_variable: Contour visibility/coverage rule only: surface-fragment owner-plane clipping -> exact centerline-ray mesh visibility plus symmetric screen capsule.

provenance.geometry: Authored analytic GT lathe mesh, 868 vertices/1728 faces; not reconstructed or RaDe-GS.
provenance.directions: Manual circumferential shade, axial stem, short cross base.
provenance.paths: 608 unit001/round002 fixed mesh-face + barycentric strokes; seed1729; no regeneration in contour unit.

exposure.note: All old geometry and view family exposed; engineering diagnostic, no held-out research claim.

renderer.hatch_and_ring_rule: unchanged per-fragment same-ray owner-plane depth + same semantic part
renderer.candidate_rule: For every covered contour supersample query mesh nearest depth at closest projected centerline point (perspective-correct line depth), accept abs gap <=.006 and emit symmetric capsule.
limits: Contour stroke can extend .4px at an occlusion endpoint; it represents screen-space outline ink.
Near-plane clipping not implemented; bounded cameras stay in front.
Existing hatch owner-plane extension approximation retained.

fixed_controls: all hatch and profile ring rules
unit001 historical NO_GO and all17 hidden-profile hits

evaluation.contour_layer: Saved separately from hatches and rings; max union happens before downsample.
evaluation.independent_reference: Continuous-lathe analytic ray geometry from frozen authored shape spec; not the candidate mesh raster.

contour_metrics.boundary: foreground inner 3x3 morphological boundary, classified by independent visible part
contour_metrics.missing: 8-connected missing boundary pixel counts; not arc length
contour_metrics.scope: Outer foreground only, not internal hidden-line proof.

controls: no-edit must have zero change and fail nonzero gate
8x8 stem blackening must increase far-other leakage

evaluation.regression: Actual hatch layers identical to unit001 all12 edited/base views; fixed IDs/coordinates unchanged. This is a secondary implementation check.

video.name: orbit
video.decode: independent complete RGB decode compared with each source PNG; all-frame and first/middle/last contacts

evaluation.hidden_profiles: Retain every one of 17 prior hidden+profile-present observations, full crops, no eligibility changes.
tests: same .8px outer contour retains symmetric coverage RED legacy -> GREEN candidate
evaluation.visual_gate: Actual complete lamp images and all-frame orbit, contour-only comparisons and native part crops. Contour repair GO requires clearly continuous readable outlines without new hidden contours/overdraw; full asset visual stays NO_GO if stem/base clutter remains.
